Interactive Individual Player Dashboard

Production Usage Instructions

Primary Function: Comprehensive individual player performance analysis across all competitive matches

Target Users: Head coach, assistant coaches, player development staff, performance analysts

Key Applications: - Pre-match preparation: Analyze recent form trends and opponent-specific performance - Player development meetings: Review progress with individual players using visual evidence - Tactical planning: Identify performance patterns to inform role assignments - Injury return assessment: Monitor performance recovery post-injury through statistical trends

Operational Guide

Step 1: Player Selection - Use the blue dropdown menu (top-left) to select any of the 15 Wake Forest players - Players are organized alphabetically for quick navigation - Selection automatically updates all visualizations in real-time

Step 2: Metric Analysis - Use the yellow dropdown menu (top-center) to choose from 70+ performance metrics - Metrics include: attacking (goals, assists, shots), passing (accuracy, progressive), defending (tackles, interceptions), physical (duels, recoveries) - Selection shows isolated trend for chosen metric across all matches

Step 3: Data Interpretation - X-axis: Match sequence (chronological order from first to most recent) - Y-axis: Metric value (raw numbers or percentages depending on metric type) - Hover functionality: Displays match details, opponent, date, and exact metric value - Trend analysis: Identify performance patterns, form peaks, and development areas

Strategic Applications

  • Form Assessment: Identify players in peak condition for upcoming fixtures
  • Development Tracking: Monitor skill progression over time for individual coaching
  • Load Management: Analyze performance degradation patterns to inform rotation
  • Tactical Suitability: Match player strengths to specific game plans and formations
  • Contract Negotiations: Provide objective performance evidence for player evaluations

Player Comparison Dashboard 2024

Advanced Analytics Interface

Primary Function: Multi-dimensional player performance comparison using percentile-based statistical analysis

Target Users: Technical directors, head coaches, recruitment specialists, performance analysts

Key Applications: - Squad depth analysis: Compare players in similar positions for tactical flexibility - Recruitment benchmarking: Evaluate potential signings against current squad standards - Player development prioritization: Identify individual improvement areas relative to peers - Contract renewal decisions: Objective performance comparison for squad planning

Technical Specifications

Data Processing: - Percentile rankings: Each metric converted to 0-100 percentile scale for fair comparison - 2024 season focus: Analysis based on most recent competitive performance - Position categorization: Goalkeeper (1), Defenders (4), Midfielders (7), Forwards (3) - Metric filtering: 49 relevant metrics selected from 70+ available statistics

Visualization Features: - Enlarged radar area: 1400x1200 pixel visualization for detailed analysis - Interactive legend: Click to toggle individual players on/off - Hover functionality: Displays raw values and percentile rankings - Color coding: Unique identification for each of the 15 squad members

Operational Protocol

Step 1: Initial Analysis - Default view: First 5 players visible, others in ‘legend only’ mode - Overall assessment: Larger polygon areas indicate superior overall performance - Relative positioning: Distance from center shows percentile ranking (0-100)

Step 2: Focused Comparison - Player selection: Click legend entries to show/hide specific players - Position-based analysis: Compare players within same positional groups - Metric interpretation: Hover over data points for exact values and percentiles

Step 3: Strategic Decision Making - Strength identification: Players excelling in outer areas of radar - Development areas: Metrics showing below 50th percentile positioning - Tactical suitability: Match radar profiles to required playing styles

Coaching Applications

  • Starting XI Selection: Choose players with complementary strength profiles
  • Substitution Strategy: Identify players who can address in-game tactical needs
  • Training Focus: Target individual weaknesses identified through percentile analysis
  • Formation Optimization: Match player profiles to tactical system requirements
  • Long-term Development: Create individualized improvement plans based on peer comparison

Team Leaders per 90 in 2024

Performance Benchmarking System

Primary Function: Comprehensive ranking system for all team members across normalized performance metrics

Target Users: Coaching staff, performance analysts, media relations, player development specialists

Key Applications: - Performance recognition: Identify and celebrate top performers in specific areas - Development targeting: Highlight players needing improvement in particular metrics - Media preparation: Provide statistical evidence for player performance discussions - Tactical planning: Understand relative squad strengths for formation and style decisions

Methodological Framework

Per-90 Normalization: - Fair comparison basis: All metrics adjusted to per-90-minute rates - Playing time independence: Accounts for varying match participation levels - Season-long analysis: Comprehensive 2024 competitive fixture coverage - Position neutrality: Rankings not influenced by tactical role differences

Dynamic Metric Selection: - 70+ available metrics: Complete performance spectrum coverage - Instant ranking updates: Real-time resorting upon metric selection - Percentage vs. raw values: Intelligent selection of most meaningful representation - Interactive interface: Green dropdown menu for seamless metric switching

Implementation Guide

Step 1: Metric Selection - Dropdown activation: Click green menu button above chart - Category navigation: Metrics organized by attacking, passing, defending, physical - Automatic updates: Rankings refresh instantly upon selection - Visual feedback: Chart title updates to reflect chosen metric

Step 2: Performance Analysis - Ranking interpretation: Left-to-right ordering from highest to lowest performance - Bar length significance: Longer bars indicate superior per-90 performance - Hover details: Exact values displayed for precise comparison - Position context: Consider player roles when interpreting rankings

Step 3: Strategic Application - Strength identification: Top performers in critical metrics for tactical leverage - Development planning: Focus training on areas where players rank lower - Squad depth assessment: Understand relative capabilities across positions - Rotation decisions: Balance performance metrics with fitness and form considerations

Professional Applications

  • Team Meetings: Present objective performance evidence to squad
  • Individual Reviews: Show players their standings in various performance areas
  • Tactical Preparation: Identify best performers for specific game plan requirements
  • Recruitment Strategy: Understand performance gaps requiring external solutions
  • Performance Bonuses: Objective criteria for individual performance incentives
